notes: Complete principal Peleș Castle exterior, including both mapped parents, all connected main and returned ranges around the actual western courtyard, the square clock tower with open gallery arches and closed clock panels, its steep roof and open lantern/spire, the polygonal half-timber front tower, two separate white turrets, slate gables and hips, closed dormers, chimneys, a closed central glass roof with fitted curb, the front veranda, through-gateway and low eastern retaining gallery. Original simplified timber and stone trim; figurative murals, sculpture, inscriptions, heraldry and interiors are excluded. Independent estate buildings, gardens and forest remain native context. Three ordinary front, court-corner and oblique aerial pictures were inspected. Rear and roof inventories, concealed joins, original clock and gable trim, window rhythm, timber patterns, terrace shapes and historic grades are medium-fi approximations. Lower garden works and independent estate structures are outside the principal-building scope. Context is synthetic; physical device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.
